subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox core own this dedicated SSM-only AWS workspace service and its ECS/CloudFormation deployment as a supported product surface?
rationale: The PR introduces a large specialized API mode, deployment stack, configuration contract, and long-term operating commitment that implementation quality and CI cannot establish as intended product direction.

options.title: Accept as supported core mode
options.body: Sponsor the dedicated AWS service as a maintained opt-in deployment after live acceptance proof, branch refresh, and changelog cleanup.

options.title: Narrow to reusable primitives
options.body: Keep the provider-capability and credential-chain improvements but move the opinionated deployment and runbook outside the supported core surface.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold or close the PR until a dedicated-account use case and long-term operational owner are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Accept as supported core mode
recommendation.body: Sponsor the dedicated AWS service as a maintained opt-in deployment after live acceptance proof, branch refresh, and changelog cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest historical and current-main ownership signal across brokered AWS, provider capabilities, and workspace runtime behavior.
